# TDrive v3.1.5

This release fixes the first-run "Choose your TDrive" channel lookup, which
could fail again and again with a Telegram flood wait, and makes Copy
diagnostics include the backend log so lookup problems can be reported with
useful detail. Bản phát hành này sửa bước "Chọn TDrive của bạn" khi chạy lần
đầu, lỗi có thể lặp lại nhiều lần do Telegram yêu cầu chờ (flood wait), và
thêm nhật ký backend vào Sao chép chẩn đoán để dễ báo cáo sự cố hơn.

## Highlights

- First run: "Choose your TDrive" no longer fails repeatedly when Telegram
  asks the app to wait. The channel lookup waits out the flood wait and
  resumes the same page instead of starting over.
- The wait message shows the correct number of seconds and is translated in
  all 19 supported languages.
- Account > About > Copy diagnostics now includes the last 300 lines of the
  backend log, with secrets and phone-like numbers redacted.

## First-run channel lookup fix

- When Telegram returns FLOOD_WAIT during the channel lookup, the app waits
  for the requested time (up to 90 seconds per wait, 5 minutes in total) and
  then continues from the page where it stopped.
- Partial progress is kept for 10 minutes, and a complete channel list is
  kept for 5 minutes. Choosing a channel no longer walks through all of your
  chats again.
- Concurrent lookups are merged, so opening the picker several times at once
  does not send duplicate requests to Telegram.

## Wait message

- The flood-wait message now shows the correct number of seconds, including
  waits longer than a minute.
- The message is translated in all 19 languages.

## Safety guards

- The chat paging loop stops when Telegram returns no progress, instead of
  repeating the same request.
- Paging is capped at 2000 pages as a final safety limit.

## Diagnostics

- Account > About > Copy diagnostics includes the last 300 lines of the
  backend log. Secrets and phone-like numbers are redacted before the text
  is copied.
- Use it when the channel lookup misbehaves and attach the copied report to
  your bug report.

## Known limits

- Real Telegram rate limits could not be reproduced without a real affected
  account. The flood-wait handling is verified with integration tests against
  a mock Telegram server, not against live Telegram behavior.
- If the lookup still fails for you, please send the output of Copy
  diagnostics with your report. It is the most useful information for
  confirming the fix.

## Internal

- Integration tests run the real Telegram client against a mock server with
  flood-wait scenarios, so the resume and no-progress guards are covered
  automatically.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.5-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Installer. A portable `TDrive-v3.1.5-windows-amd64.zip` is also attached. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `TDrive-v3.1.5-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip and drag TDrive to Applications. |
| Linux (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.5-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it, then run it. Needs glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| Android 7.0 or newer (ARM64) | `TDrive-v3.1.5-android-arm64.apk` | Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 16 or newer) | `TDrive-v3.1.5-ios-unsigned.ipa` | Not signed. Install with TrollStore, Sideloadly or AltStore. |

## Integrity

- `checksums.txt` lists SHA-256 digests for the downloadable packages.
- `checksums.txt.sig` authenticates that manifest for the desktop updater using the embedded Ed25519 trust keys.
